The '''Montgomery Processing Center''' is a private [[immigration detention center]] located in [[Conroe, Texas]]. It is operated by the GEO Group, a private prison corporation, under contract from the United States [[United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement|Immigration and Customs Enforcement]].

The facility was expanded from a capacity of 1,000 to 1,314 detainees in 2019.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-06-05 |title=The GEO Group Announces 314-Bed Contract Capacity Expansion at Montgomery Processing Center in Texas |url=https://investors.geogroup.com/news-releases/news-release-details/geo-group-announces-314-bed-contract-capacity-expansion/ |access-date=2026-03-27 |website=GEO Group}}</ref>

The Montgomery ICE Processing Center has a significant number of detainees in [[solitary confinement]]: 109 detainees in 2022 and 210 in 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Brigida |first=Anna-Catherine |date=2024-02-19 |title=Solitary confinement on the rise for immigrants in Houston |url=https://houstonlanding-newspack.newspackstaging.com/solitary-confinement-cases-are-on-the-rise-for-detained-immigrants-in-houston/ |access-date=2026-03-27 |website=Houston Landing |language=en-US}}</ref> A 2014 investigation by Houston Landing found that at least five detainees had been held for longer than the 15-day period in solitary considered [[torture]] by the [[United Nations]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Brigida |first=Anna-Catherine |date=2024-08-12 |title=Solitary confinement common at Houston ICE detention center |url=https://houstonlanding-newspack.newspackstaging.com/worst-nightmare-of-my-life-solitary-confinement-rises-at-houston-area-ice-detention-center/ |access-date=2026-03-27 |website=Houston Landing |language=en-US}}</ref> In 2026, the [[The Texas Observer|Texas Observer]] reported overcrownding at the facility with 60 people held in cell blocks intended for 45, and unsanitary conditions at the facility.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Buch |first=Jason |date=2026-02-09 |title=How Trump's ICE Is Locking Up Longtime Texans with Paths to Legal Status |url=https://www.texasobserver.org/trump-ice-detention-bond-prosecutorial-discretion/ |access-date=2026-03-27 |website=The Texas Observer |language=en-US}}</ref>
